mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_close_approval (id, period_close_id, approval_role, actor_id, decision, approved_close_hash, decision_time, create_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{periodCloseId}, #{approvalRole}, #{actorId}, #{decision}, #{approvedCloseHash}, #{decisionTime}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, period_close_id, approval_role, actor_id, decision, approved_close_hash, decision_time, create_time FROM t_close_approval WHERE period_close_id = #{periodCloseId} ORDER BY id
